Tables 1 and 2 print mean SCP amplitudes without a unit; a microvolt unit appears only inside the figure axes (pixels), so no unit is attached to those cells.

Dash cells in Tables 1 and 2 (training days without usable mean SCP amplitudes) are missing cells, not zero values, and are not recorded as facts; the captions give two alternative reasons and do not say which applied to which day.
Table 1 and 2 cell times are the Block and Day column headers; the day number is carried in the observation name because the Day header cells hold bare numerals.

Author interpretations and hypotheses (hedged TFI-based statements about sleep, optimism and cognitive clarity, mechanisms of the pitch change, why left-hemisphere effects were larger, cortical excitation threshold) are not extracted as patient facts; one hedged observation is kept review_only.

The introduction, the literature comparisons and the mechanistic discussion describe other studies and are background; discussion sentences that restate Tables 1 to 5 are merged into the matching table-cell facts instead of being repeated.

Only the THI states a time ("before the training"); the baseline audiometry, BDI and HFA sentences state no time and are not given one.

Table 3 percentage cells, the Table 1 and 2 Difference rows, one decimal-comma cell, and several text-versus-table label differences are kept as printed and recorded as ambiguities; audiometry frequency range is recorded as a source conflict.
The patient's initials occur only inside verbatim evidence quotes; no authored field contains them.
